sections.title: Day Shift — Team 2 (09:00 – 17:00)
items: Team 2 — Guards: Beni and Mya. Rostered 09:00–17:00.
Team 1 completed briefing with Team 2. Area coverage confirmed, equipment provided and checked. Commenced patrols from headquarters.

09:10–14:20 patrol cycle: patrolled Upper Queen Street, Lower Queen Street, Vulcan Lane, Customs Street, High Street, Chancery Square, Fort Street, Pocket Park, Fort Lane, Gore Street, Britomart, Commercial Bay, and Lorne Street.
Welfare checks completed across the patrol cycle; all staff spoken to and no issues reported.
Gore Street businesses and Auckland Harbour Suites
Assisted a member of the public with directions to a location. Patrol continued.
Began heading back towards headquarters for changeover; stood by for calls from Team 1.
Morning shift began handover to afternoon shift. Afternoon shift deployed; Team 2 headed downstairs to continue patrols.

14:35–16:30 patrol cycle: patrolled Upper Queen Street, Lower Queen Street, Vulcan Lane, Customs Street, High Street, Chancery Square, Fort Street, Pocket Park, Fort Lane, Gore Street, Britomart, Commercial Bay, and Lorne Street.
Received a request to remove a male individual from Danny Doolans Bar in the Viaduct area. Team contacted management and proceeded; on arrival the male had already left. No further issues.
While walking back towards headquarters, Team 2 noticed a protest at Shed 10 near the Downtown Ferry Terminal. Team assisted Police at the scene and stood by, maintaining visible security presence.
Returned to headquarters for 30-minute break; stood by for response calls from Team 1.
Team 2 shift completed. Equipment accounted for and handed over. Team 2 stood down.

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:30 – 22:11)
items: Equipment received: 4x Keys, 2x Swipe Cards, 2x Vests, 1x Ops Phone.
Afternoon shift arrived and stood by while morning shift completed Auror and patrol reports.
Morning shift finished and signed off. Afternoon shift deployed after debrief with Team 2.
Debrief completed with Team 2. Guards geared up.
Patrols commenced towards Commercial Bay with welfare checks along the way.
Arrived at Commercial Bay. Welfare checks completed at McDonald’s Britomart and Queen Street stores. All clear.
Response call from Kiwiana regarding a suspicious male individual inside the store with his scooter.
Arrived at Kiwiana. Guards asked the individual to vacate the premises. Security presence maintained in case he returned.
Guards took cover due to weather conditions while continuing patrol under shelter.
Security presence maintained at McDonald’s Queen Street.
Patrol continued through Queen Street towards Elliott Street. Welfare checks completed on stores.
Response call from 125 Queen Street regarding a male sleeping outside the shop. Security had asked him to vacate, but he did not comply. Assistance requested.
Arrived at 125 Queen Street. Guards approached the vagrant sleeping on the footpath; he left the location. Security presence maintained. Bodycam footage captured.
Patrol continued down Queen Street towards Commercial Bay. Welfare checks completed at McDonald’s Britomart, Commercial Bay, and surrounding stores.
Patrol continued up Albert Street maintaining visible presence.
Patrol commenced down Wyndham Street. Chemist Warehouse checked. All clear.
Returned to headquarters to charge Ops phone due to low battery at 8%.
Response call from McDonald’s Queen Street regarding a female vagrant outside the door begging and asking for food. On arrival she had already left.
Patrol continued up Queen Street maintaining visible presence.
Sweep completed down Lorne Street; a few vagrants present but no issues to report.
Response call from Cotton On Queen Street regarding a vagrant who had stolen a jacket. Guards completed a sweep but were unable to locate the suspect. Security presence maintained.
Full sweep of High Street commenced.
Fire reported on Fort Lane with fire trucks outside the building. Guards stood by to maintain presence. Footage captured on Ops phone.

Observed a male vagrant yelling and acting aggressively towards Asian members of the public and another vagrant. Guards asked him to calm down; he initially did but began hitting properties and objects. Guards followed for ~5 minutes, called 111 with a full description. Police arrived ~2 minutes later and arrested the vagrant.
A group of members of the public were seen with open cans of alcohol. Guards asked them to dispose of the cans, which were retrieved. Patrol continued through Commercial Bay.

Came across a vagrant consuming alcohol on Albert Street. When approached he became verbally aggressive and refused to dispose of the alcohol. Guards issued a verbal warning regarding alcohol in the CBD and he moved off.
